name: nix-ai-stack
description: An open-source AI stack for disciplined software delivery.

scripts.config:init: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js config:init
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js doctor
scripts.reviewers:list: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js reviewers:list
scripts.reviewers:run: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js reviewers:run
scripts.arch:select: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js arch:select
scripts.release:manifest: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js release:manifest --root=. --out=dist/release-manifest.json
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run release:manifest && npm run release:verify
